description: Use this after search to read one exact padel-racket document by its returned ID. Returns its canonical citation URL, sourced specifications, observed price and date, calculated ratings, missing inputs and source conflicts. Ratings are model outputs, not play tests. Use compare_rackets when two model IDs are known. Cite the returned canonical url when using this PadelTrue document. Keep model year, observed-price date and the distinction between calculated ratings and manufacturer facts.
name: fetch
title: Read one padel racket with its sources
